text: Ogiꞌ dali deꞌ adon Lazarus, iyoh monam.  Iyoh loꞌo samah-samah duoh madih-e deꞌ dayung, deꞌ adon   , deꞌ kupuaꞌ Betania.
It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.
Yohmoꞌ soꞌ duwoh madih-e pait gah tuduꞌ Yesus nang in-e, “Gulu, iyoh deꞌ obuah ngibalaꞌ odaꞌ Ingan, monam.”
Takal Yesus ngojit gah inoh, Iyoh moꞌ in-e, “Onam inoh idoh diꞌ-e yaꞌ odaꞌ yoh kobos, pak-e onam inoh ogiꞌ saꞌ nyaꞌa ningaꞌ kuasa Topaꞌ deꞌ ayuh, saꞌ nyaꞌa mudi duoh pimodo tuduꞌ Onak Topaꞌ.”
Tok bonal Yesus ngibalaꞌ Marta, Maria, duoh Lazarus,
pak-e takal Yesus ngojit gah nang Lazarus monam, Iyoh saji-e loꞌo duwoh onu lagiꞌ deꞌ topat inoh.
Mokuaꞌ inoh ke Iyoh moꞌ in-e tuduꞌ pinunaꞌ-pinunaꞌ-E, “Jaꞌ mey otoꞌ paliꞌ odi lagiꞌ keꞌ Yudea.”
Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ nyawot, “Gulu, baꞌuh geh ulang-ulang Yahudi yaꞌ nyokad Ingan pakai batuh ngan-e yaꞌ ngabos Ingan, adin Ingan yaꞌ paliꞌ lagiꞌ kanih?”

Yesus moꞌ nyawot-e pakai nang silita, “Maꞌ ingan yaꞌ tolu.  Idoh keh diꞌ-e onu jawaꞌ simoong duwoh jam daang niꞌ onu? Nyaꞌa deꞌ ponu daang onu jawaꞌ iyoh diꞌ-e simikiak dop-e iyoh kilin jawaꞌ deꞌ dunia itih.
Pak-e nyaꞌa deꞌ ponu daang onu ngalom, iyoh simikiak dop-e doiꞌ jawaꞌ deꞌ kilin-e.”
In inoh leh in Yesus.  Mokuaꞌ inoh Yesus moꞌ in-e lagiꞌ, “Dingan otoꞌ Lazarus moꞌ boꞌos, pak-e Okuꞌ yaꞌ odi kanoꞌ ngan Kuꞌ odaꞌ iyoh ngooh.”
Pinunaꞌ-pinunaꞌ Yesus moꞌ in-e, “Gulu, moꞌ Lazarus boꞌos, iyoh yaꞌ mokuaꞌ soꞌ onam-e.”
Sibonal-e Yesus tanon nang Lazarus moꞌ kobos, pak-e odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ baꞌ-e nang Yesus nang Lazarus boꞌos biasa.
Noh leh ngan Yesus moꞌ sina tanon deꞌ sibonal-e, in-E, “Lazarus moꞌ kobos.
Pak-e Okuꞌ sonang dop-e Okuꞌ doiꞌ danoꞌ takal inoh.  Dop-e ogiꞌ paguh-e saꞌan ingan, saꞌ ingan dapod bisayaꞌ.  Adin, jaꞌ otoꞌ odi tuduꞌ Lazarus.”
Tomas deꞌ sobot nyaꞌa geh nang Didimus moꞌ in-e tuduꞌ dingan-dingan-e deꞌ samah-samah jadin pinunaꞌ Yesus, “Jaꞌ otoꞌ suwaꞌ odi duoh Gulu, saꞌ otoꞌ kobos samah-samah duoh-E!”
Takal Yesus nog sinok kupuaꞌ Betania, Iyoh moꞌ ngojit soꞌ nyaꞌa nang todang Lazarus moꞌ pat onu daang kubul.
Betania diꞌ-e sikiya juuaꞌ soꞌ Yerusalem, kulang lobih taluh kilometel geh.
Bogoꞌ ulang-ulang Yahudi deꞌ moꞌ nog tuduꞌ Marta duoh Maria ngan-e yaꞌ ngilibul odop-e deꞌ duwoh deꞌ susah otin-e odaꞌ madih-e deꞌ dali deꞌ moꞌ doiꞌ.
Takal Marta ngojit nang Yesus moꞌ sinok-e yaꞌ nog, iyoh lasuꞌ odi bitapod duoh Yesus, pak-e Maria loꞌo deꞌ boli.
Marta moꞌ in-e tuduꞌ Yesus, “Gulu, simoꞌ ingan ogiꞌ datiꞌ takal inoh, pasti madih kuꞌ deꞌ dali itih diꞌ-e kobos.
Pak-e adin tuang puꞌan kuꞌ geh nang Topaꞌ yaꞌ ngin tuduꞌ Ingan suaꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ mitiaꞌ Ingan tuduꞌ-E.”
Yesus moꞌ in-e tuduꞌ Marta, “Madih muꞌ deꞌ dali yaꞌ paliꞌ mokat idip.”
In Marta tuduꞌ-E, “Puꞌan kuꞌ nang iyoh yaꞌ paliꞌ mokat idip takal piobuaꞌ dunia takal suaꞌ nyaꞌa paliꞌ mokat idip.”
Yesus moꞌ nyawot-e, “Okuꞌ leh deꞌ odaꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ moꞌ kobos paliꞌ mokat idip duoh deꞌ ngin idip tuduꞌ nyaꞌa.  Nyaꞌa deꞌ bisayaꞌ tuduꞌ Okuꞌ, iyoh yaꞌ idip bial-e moꞌ kobos.
Nyaꞌa deꞌ idip duoh deꞌ bisayaꞌ tuduꞌ Okuꞌ, iyoh doiꞌ sidoh-e yaꞌ kobos.  Bisayaꞌ yeh muꞌu duoh sina deꞌ nang Kuꞌ itih?”
Marta moꞌ nyawot-E, “Gulu, okuꞌ bisayaꞌ nang Ingan Onak Topaꞌ, Laja Pinyilamat deꞌ nog kaang dunia.”
Mokuaꞌ sina in inoh Marta moꞌ paliꞌ keꞌ boli-e yohmoꞌ mogan Maria, madih-e deꞌ dayung.  Marta moꞌ bikayas tuduꞌ-e in-e, “Gulu ogiꞌ danih, Iyoh mitiaꞌ odaꞌ muꞌu odi kanih.”
Maria ngojit deꞌ in inoh iyoh lasuꞌ mokat yohmoꞌ odi bitapod duoh Yesus.
Takal inoh Yesus aluaꞌ diꞌ-e nog kupuaꞌ inoh, Iyoh aluaꞌ deꞌ topat soꞌ Marta bitapod duoh-E.

Takal inoh bogoꞌ ulang Yahudi deꞌ nog keꞌ boli Maria ngan-e yaꞌ ngilibul-e.  Takal odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ ningaꞌ Maria mokat yohmoꞌ likas-likas luah soꞌ boli-e, odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ bitunaꞌ duoh-e, dop-e baꞌ-e nang Maria odi siꞌian keꞌ kubul.
Takal Maria nog deꞌ topat Yesus duoh ningaꞌ-E, iyoh moꞌ bikunyug deꞌ sulung jowin-E daang-e in-e, “Gulu, simoꞌ Ingan ogiꞌ datiꞌ takal inoh, pasti madih kuꞌ deꞌ dali diꞌ-e kobos.”
Takal Yesus ningaꞌ Maria siꞌian, ulang-ulang Yahudi deꞌ suwaꞌ nog duoh Maria suwaꞌ geh siꞌian, otin Yesus moꞌ sukup nyam susah-E duoh ngilobuꞌ.
Yesus moꞌ sikian tuduꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ in-E, “Daki soꞌ ingan ngubul-e?” Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ moꞌ in-e, “Gulu, jaꞌ otoꞌ odi ningaꞌ kubul-e.”
Yesus moꞌ duwan siꞌian-E.
Ulang-ulang Yahudi deꞌ munoꞌ moꞌ in-e, “Ningaꞌ, Iyoh sukup ngibalaꞌ Lazarus.”
Pak-e ogiꞌ deꞌ soꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ deꞌ in-e, “Iyoh odaꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ butaꞌ ponai kilin.  Sipatut-e Iyoh tuang ponai geh odaꞌ Lazarus mokuaꞌ soꞌ onam-e saꞌ-e diꞌ-e kobos.”
Yesus moꞌ paliꞌ ngilobuꞌ otin-E, yohmoꞌ odi keꞌ kubul.  Kubul inoh lubang gua deꞌ kuab nyaꞌa pakai batuh deꞌ ayuh.
Yesus moꞌ in-e, “Sigian batuh inoh.” Marta madih nyaꞌa deꞌ kobos inoh moꞌ in-e tuduꞌ Yesus, “Gulu, iyoh moꞌ pat onu daang kubul, iyoh moꞌ buꞌun moduaꞌ.”
Yesus moꞌ nyawot-e, “Moꞌ mokuaꞌ Kuꞌ tanon tuduꞌ muꞌu nang moꞌ muꞌu bisayaꞌ, muꞌu yaꞌ ningaꞌ kuasa Topaꞌ deꞌ sukup ayuh-e!”
Kudu-kudu naꞌan odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ moꞌ sigian batuh inoh.  Yesus moꞌ bigalong keꞌ longit simadi-E sina, “Samaꞌ, Okuꞌ bisukul tuduꞌ Ingan dop-e Ingan moꞌ ngojit Okuꞌ.
Okuꞌ puꞌan nang Ingan silalu ngojit Okuꞌ, pak-e Okuꞌ nang in itih saꞌan nyaꞌa deꞌ ogiꞌ datiꞌ saꞌ odop-e deꞌ mutiꞌ bisayaꞌ nang Ingan leh deꞌ pait Okuꞌ.”
Takal Yesus mokuaꞌ nang sina deꞌ in inoh, Iyoh moꞌ mogan Lazarus dolas-dolas-e in-e, “Lazarus luah mey!”

Dali deꞌ kobos inoh moꞌ luah soꞌ aang lubang gua deꞌ jadin kubul-e.  Soꞌ duwoh tongan poꞌon-e aluaꞌ bibolut kain todang duoh jowin-e obuah nutu pakai sapu tongan.  Yesus moꞌ in-e tuduꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ, “Bukaꞌ leh kain-kain deꞌ molut gonan-e, nyeꞌ moꞌ tanah saꞌ-e buu.”
Bogoꞌ soꞌ ulang-ulang Yahudi deꞌ nog tuduꞌ Maria moꞌ ningaꞌ oni deꞌ nai Yesus.  Bogoꞌ soꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ deꞌ bisayaꞌ tuduꞌ Yesus.
Pak-e ogiꞌ soꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ odi tuduꞌ uluk ulang Farisi ngan-e tanon tuduꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ moꞌ nai Yesus inoh.
Yohmoꞌ ayua pimipin agama Yahudi deꞌ ayuh duoh uluk ulang Farisi ngijaꞌ Pengadilan Agama tikuluk.  Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ moꞌ in-e, “Oni mey wat toꞌ neh? Nyaꞌa itih bogoꞌ nai tanda-tanda deꞌ ilan nyaꞌa!
Simoꞌ toꞌ tanah Iyoh deꞌ wat itih, suaꞌ nyaꞌa yaꞌ bisayaꞌ tuduꞌ-E, yohmoꞌ pimipin ulang Roma yaꞌ nog ngasul Boli Topaꞌ duoh bangsa otoꞌ!”
Ogiꞌ niꞌ naꞌan soꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ deꞌ adon Kayafas deꞌ jadin Pimipin Agama Yahudi deꞌ Paling Ayuh takal sowaꞌ inoh.  Iyoh sina in-e, “Ingan diꞌ ingan puꞌan oni-oni-e!
Ingan diꞌ ingan bingoon nang paguh dooꞌ kaꞌan ingan, niꞌ naꞌan nyaꞌa kobos saꞌan bangsa otoꞌ, saꞌ suaꞌ bangsa otoꞌ diꞌ-e mutuab.”

Sibonal-e sina deꞌ nang-e inoh, idoh diꞌ-e soꞌ odop-e sadiꞌ-e.  Pak-e ngan iyoh deꞌ jadin Pimipin Agama Yahudi deꞌ Paling Ayuh sowaꞌ inoh, iyoh moꞌ tanon sibaya soꞌ Topaꞌ deꞌ nang-e Yesus yaꞌ kobos saꞌan bangsa Yahudi.
Iyoh yaꞌ kobos idoh diꞌ-e jok-e saꞌan bangsa Yahudi sijaꞌ-e, pak-e ngan-e nguluk onak-onak Topaꞌ deꞌ ogiꞌ daki-daki sijaꞌ-a saꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ tikuluk.
Mulai soꞌ onu inoh odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ bipokat yaꞌ ngabos Yesus.

Noh leh ngan Yesus diꞌ-e tiyaꞌ bitanga odop-E deꞌ jowin nyaꞌa deꞌ bogoꞌ soꞌ bangsa Yahudi.  Iyoh buu soꞌ kanoꞌ keꞌ kota deꞌ adon Efraim, deꞌ sinok padang pasil.  Iyoh moꞌ loꞌo danoꞌ samah-samah duoh pinunaꞌ-pinunaꞌ-E.

Takal inoh Onu Ayuh Paskah ulang Yahudi moꞌ sinok, yohmoꞌ bogoꞌ nyaꞌa soꞌ kupuaꞌ-kupuaꞌ odi keꞌ Yerusalem.  Dop-e nunaꞌ adat ulang Yahudi, nyaꞌa deꞌ munoꞌ halus kibisig odop-e takal-e aluaꞌ diꞌ-e nog onu Paskah.
Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ kalik Yesus duoh simadi-e mujuag deꞌ limang Boli Topaꞌ, odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ sina tipan si odop-e in-e, “Oni nyam nunaꞌ pikil ingan, oni keh Iyoh yaꞌ nog keh idoh daang onu ayuh itih?”

Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ nang in inoh dop-e pimipin-pimipin agama Yahudi deꞌ ayuh duoh uluk ulang Farisi moꞌ ngin pilitah, nang osi sijaꞌ-e deꞌ puꞌan daki soꞌ Yesus, halus lapol saꞌ odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ dapod takap-E.
